summary: Created a persistent LVM logical volume mounted at /srv/data, grew it online from 1 GiB to 2 GiB, preserved its contents, and verified automatic recovery after reboot. Ubuntu 24.04.3 and kernel 6.8.0-71 remain unchanged.
actions_performed: Created a 3 GiB persistent file-backed LVM physical volume because no unallocated disk was available.
Created vg_data/lv_data, formatted it as ext4, and mounted it at /srv/data.
Added checksum-protected test content before expansion.
Expanded the mounted LV and filesystem online from 1 GiB to 2,147,483,648 bytes.
Configured boot-time loop attachment, LVM activation, and UUID-based mounting.
Corrected early-boot ordering so the backing device attaches after the root filesystem becomes writable.
Restarted node1 and verified boot identity change, storage recovery, data integrity, and normal system health.

evidence.requirement: Logical volume mounted at /srv/data with pre-growth content
evidence.summary: Shows the initial 1 GiB vg_data/lv_data mounted read-write at /srv/data and both protected files passing checksum verification.

evidence.requirement: Online growth to at least 2 GB while mounted with contents intact
evidence.summary: Shows online lvextend/resize2fs, confirms the mount source stayed unchanged, reports an LV size of 2,147,483,648 bytes, and verifies both checksums.

evidence.requirement: First node1 restart sequence and recovery work
evidence.summary: Captures the healthy baseline, reboot acknowledgement, changed boot ID, and recovered mount/data after correcting the discovered ordering cycle.

evidence.requirement: Second node1 restart sequence and recovery work
evidence.summary: Captures baseline, acknowledgement, changed boot ID, diagnosis and correction of read-only early attachment, restored checksums, and normal running state.

evidence.requirement: Final node1 restart persistence and complete recovery
evidence.summary: Shows final healthy baseline, reboot acknowledgement, boot ID changing from 363f7a1c-5acb-453f-b45c-f35dd5b130ec to a5ba7287-852a-4391-b81d-1d82eac7eb49, writable loop/PV/VG/LV recovery, active /srv/data mount, 2 GiB LV size, passing checksums, no failed units, and unchanged OS/kernel.
